attributes.title: Technical attributes

empty.title: No attributes
empty.description: The attribute matrix has no attributes for this subcategory.

edit.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why the value is being changed
edit.evidenceRequired: Required: prove the new value with a screenshot, or with the source URL and excerpt.

rejection.NO_EVIDENCE_FOR_CANDIDATE: A candidate was kept, but no extracted evidence supports the value.
rejection.EVIDENCE_VALUE_MISMATCH: The candidate differs from the value its own source states; check both before publishing.
rejection.NOT_IN_VOCABULARY: The value found at the source is not in the attribute vocabulary.
rejection.TAXONOMY_MISMATCH: Removed: a taxonomy attribute must match the product's category or subcategory exactly.

applicability.CANDIDATE_NEEDS_REVIEW: There is a candidate that needs human validation.
applicability.EVIDENCE_FOUND: The research found evidence for this attribute.
applicability.OPTIONAL_NO_CANDIDATE: Optional attribute with no candidate or evidence for this product.
applicability.NOT_IN_MATRIX: The attribute is not in the applicable matrix or was marked as not applicable.

attributes.description: Each value with how it is backed. Open an attribute to compare it with its sources, attach evidence or edit it; every edit needs its own evidence.
attributes.noMatches: No attribute matches the search or the filter.

evidence.title: Facts and sources
evidence.empty: No facts were researched for this product yet.
evidence.description: Every fact the agent researched, with the pages that state it.

issues.title: Deterministic validations
issues.description: Checks run by code on the result: rules, vocabularies and evidence. Open an attribute to fix it.

review.title: Review decision
review.staleDecision: The previous decision ({{status}}) was made on an older enrichment result. Review this result and decide again.
review.description: The decision applies to this result and the edits shown here.
review.notesPlaceholder: What you checked, and why you decided

options.IN_REVIEW: You are checking this product; the decision comes later.
options.APPROVED: The result and its edits are published at the next publication.

readiness.open: Still open in this result: {{errors}} errors, {{warnings}} warnings and {{missing}} required attributes without value.
readiness.clean: Every validation passed and every required attribute has a value.

history.title: History

events.ATTRIBUTE_OVERRIDE_SUPERSEDED: Edit replaced by a newer one

history.reopenedReason: An edit or evidence changed after the approval, so the product needs a new decision.

evidenceForm.excerptPlaceholder: Copy the text of the page that shows the value
evidenceForm.fileHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB. Ctrl+V pastes from the clipboard.
evidenceForm.notePlaceholder: Context for whoever audits this later

problems.imageType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
problems.imageSize: The screenshot must be at most 10 MB.
problems.https: The source URL must start with https://.
problems.missing: Attach a screenshot, or enter the source URL and the excerpt that proves the value.

evidenceForm.dropTitle: Drop, paste or choose a screenshot
evidenceForm.or: or prove it with the source page
evidenceForm.ready: The evidence is enough to save.

crop.failed: The crop could not be loaded. The file may be unavailable or you may not have access to it.

page.failed: The page screenshot could not be loaded. The file may be unavailable or you may not have access to it.

manual.failed: The uploaded screenshot could not be loaded. The file may be unavailable or you may not have access to it.

audit.description: Check the proposed value and the sources behind it before approving or editing.
audit.overrideNote: The sources below support the original AI value; the manual evidence supports this edit.

restoreDialog.title: Restore the original AI value?
restoreDialog.description: The edit “{{edited}}” will be removed and the attribute will show “{{original}}” again. The history stays available in the product audit.

sources.title: Sources that back the value
sources.description: From the most to the least reputable. The reference capture comes from the first one that could show the value.

referenceCapture.title: Reference capture
referenceCapture.fallback: The most reputable source ({{host}}) could not be captured: {{reason}}. This capture comes from the next source on the list.
referenceCapture.manualForEdit: Attached by a reviewer for the edited value.
referenceCapture.manualForAi: Attached by a reviewer: no source could show the value.
referenceCapture.noneReason: No source could show the value. On the most reputable one ({{host}}), {{reason}}. Check the sources below or attach your own evidence.
referenceCapture.legacy: This enrichment predates visual captures: the sources below back the value by text.

reason.PAGE_NOT_CAPTURED: the page could not be captured
reason.UNSUPPORTED: the source has no visual capture
reason.NO_MATCH: the value was not found in the capture
reason.AMBIGUOUS: the value appears in more than one place on the page
reason.UNSTABLE: the page changed while it was captured
reason.NOT_ON_PAGE: the value is not in the page text
reason.HIDDEN: the value stayed hidden after opening its section
reason.STRUCTURED_DATA_ONLY: the value is only in the page data, not on the visible page
reason.BLOCKED: the site blocked the focused capture
reason.PAGE_CHANGED: the page changed address when its section was opened
reason.FIRECRAWL_REJECTED: the capture service refused the request
reason.BUDGET: the product's capture limit was reached
reason.TOO_MANY: the page had too many values for one capture
reason.BLANK: the page was not rendered (blank capture)
reason.TEXT_ONLY: the source backs the value by text only

audit.noUrls: No URL is linked to this attribute. Do not approve a filled value without validating an external source.

manual.title: Manual evidence
manual.forEdit: Proof attached by reviewers for the edited value.
manual.forAi: Proof attached by reviewers for the AI value.

audit.editNote: The edit is recorded with its evidence; an approved product goes back to review.
